# embodies

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:embodies`](gmeow-embodies.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/embodies>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) to the [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) it embodies. Non-functional: a collected edition may embody multiple Expressions. Inverse of [`gmeow:embodiedIn`](gmeow-embodiedIn.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) -> [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:embodies`](gmeow-embodies.md) from [`gmeow:Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) to [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to climb from a concrete edition/format up to the [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) it embodies — the [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md)→[`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) R-relation of the WEMI spine.

### Avoid when

- Avoid skipping the [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) tier to point a [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) straight at a [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) (go through [`gmeow:embodies`](gmeow-embodies.md) → [`gmeow:realizes`](gmeow-realizes.md)), and avoid it for a single copy (use [`gmeow:exemplifies`](gmeow-exemplifies.md)).

### How to use

- Assert from the [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) to its [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md); a collected/omnibus edition may embody several Expressions (non-functional). Read the inverse [`gmeow:embodiedIn`](gmeow-embodiedIn.md) for Expression-rooted traversal.
